title: Warm Crispy Norwegian Chicken Fried Rice
description: A cultured and cozy Norwegian dish featuring chicken breasts and crispy fried rice, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the grated carrot and cook until tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the chicken breasts to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Add the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Cook the rice for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until crispy and golden brown.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce and salt.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
